response.original_title: じぶんを守ろう！ふしぎの国のアリス ワルワル軍団ドクドクの巻
response.overview: Alice continues her adventures in Wonderland, encountering troublesome characters whose tricks help teach children important personal safety lessons. Through three stories, she discovers why caution is necessary when dealing with strangers, how seemingly friendly people may use deception, and why even familiar individuals should not always be trusted. With guidance from the Hatter, Alice learns to recognize suspicious behavior and protect herself in potentially dangerous situations.
response.title: Protect Yourself! Alice in Wonderland: Dokudoku and the Villainous Gang

titles.title: Jibun wo Mamorou! Fushigi no Kuni no Alice: Waruwaru Gundan Dokudoku no Maki
